caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular flag featuring thirteen horizontal stripes alternating between red and a light beige color. In the top left corner, there is a blue rectangular field containing thirty-four white stars arranged in a pattern that forms a larger star. Across one of the central red stripes, the words "RED LION MOUNTED GUARD." are written in white capital letters. The flag is bordered on three sides by a yellow fringe. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Flag: Civil War
